It symbolizes the importance of progress and accomplishments in life, reminding us that growth is a continuous process. In traditional Indian literature and iconography, the goddess Gati is often depicted as a divine elephant, highlighting the association between wisdom, strength, and the journey towards self-realization.

It is believed that through our actions, intentions, and thoughts, we create the path for our spiritual growth, and the name Gati is a reminder to strive towards higher consciousness and self-realization. The name also invokes the grace and blessings of the goddess Saraswati, who is the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom, as well as the god Vishnu, who represents progress and protection. Ultimately, the name Gati serves as a reminder to remain focused on our spiritual journey and to practice virtues that lead us towards a more fulfilling and enlightened life.
